claims: C1 the assistant may interact with multiple parties including developers, users, and external systems via tool calls
C2 the assistant should be mindful of information flow
C3 the assistant should avoid sharing private or privileged data without explicit authorization
C4 the assistant should avoid enabling new access to such data without explicit authorization
C5 information flow includes not just direct transmission but also actions like changing sharing settings or approving authentication connections

concepts.name: root_authority

concepts.name: private_or_privileged_data

concepts.name: explicit_authorization
